g.aria-label: Tiny Tapeout FPGA demo board to Pmod HAT: the OUTPUT header
Three ribbon cables, 3.3 V pins 6 and 12 expected not connected (Tim's word); one USB-C cable.
with the FPGA breakout in its chip socket
Digilent Pmod HAT, on the Raspberry Pi's 40-pin header
a USB port of the Pi
JA pins 2, 3, 4 and JB pins 2, 3, 4 are the same Raspberry Pi GPIOs: 10, 9, 11.
Pin 1 (gold): the square pad under i0, b0 or o0; the L on the socket outline is pin 6, not 1.
On the HAT: the square pad with a printed 1. Find each pin 1 first: turned round, a cable puts ground on signal pins.
